title: Battle of Skalitz
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Skalitz", at revision 1370589485, opens: "The Battle of Skalitz was a minor engagement in the Königgratz/Sadowa campaign of the Austro-Prussian War of 1866 in Bohemia on 28 June. Following the Prussian victory at the Battle of Náchod the previous day, the Prussian forces, led by General of the Infantry Steinmetz, advanced on Skalitz and defeated the forces of Archduke Leopold." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q670005, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
